reason: My group already books through the ticket apps we know, and they work fine. I'm not moving eight people onto a brand-new app that launches on 1 November and adds R8 to every booking when nothing's actually broken.
objection: R8 on top of every booking adds up, and I lose it if I cancel. On top of that it's a new app nobody in my group has used, so why switch?
would_change_my_mind: If it had an event my friends wanted that I couldn't get on my usual apps, or if one of the group used it first and said it was smooth, with no booking fee on the first booking.
